highlights.title: Turkey police disperse pro-LGBTQ protesters with tear gas
highlights.summary: Turkish police fired tear gas at pro-LGBTQ demonstrators in the western city of Izmir on Monday, as activists protested a nationwide crackdown that saw dozens arrested over the weekend in a campaign authorities described as defending traditional family values.
